abstract: Accurate forecasts of retirement and Social Security (SS) claiming behavior are important for projecting the long-run costs of public pension and social-insurance systems. We study whether machine learning methods, applied to a rich set of household-level variables, can improve predictions of retirement and SS claiming decisions. Our model predicts the share of SS beneficiaries with an error of less than 1 percentage point, while the benchmark model used by the Social Security Administration (SSA) has an error of more than 3 percentage points. A conservative calculation implies that this difference corresponds to about 35.16 billion dollars per year in aggregate benefits. In a 2020 forecasting exercise using models trained on pre-2018 data, our model retains strong predictive performance during COVID-19 and outperforms the SSA benchmark. We also find that our model performs better across groups defined by expected SS benefits, with especially large gains among individuals with high expected benefits. In addition, the variables selected by our model differ from those emphasized in the SSA benchmark. Using Shapley values, we show that variable contributions are often nonlinear.
title: Predicting retirement and Social Security claiming decisions using machine learning

abstract: The rise of protectionism and the growing fragmentation of global trade raise important yet under-explored questions about their environmental consequences. This paper investigates the C O 2 emission consequences of reciprocal tariff wars with statistical regressions and structural quantitative simulations. Empirical analysis of the China-US tariff war in 2018 proved a significant increase in global CO2 emissions. We develop a multi-country general equilibrium model that incorporates endogenous production reallocation and sectoral carbon intensities to quantify how tariff retaliation and trade fragmentation reshape global emission patterns. The results show that reciprocal tariffs systematically increase global C O 2 emissions. Although tariffs reduce aggregate output, the structural reallocation of production toward more carbon-intensive regions, and the loss of economies of scale that increases emission intensity, dominates the contractionary effect, resulting in a net rise in world emissions. Trade conflicts involving systemically important economies, particularly China-US and US-EU, generate substantially larger emission increases than disputes with smaller trading partners. Moreover, trade decoupling produces significantly stronger emission increases than reciprocal tariff escalation, highlighting the climate risks associated with supply-chain fragmentation. These results underscore the importance of coordinating trade and climate policies to prevent trade fragmentation from undermining global decarbonization efforts.

abstract: Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。
title: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助

abstract: This paper examines how Philippine households organize their energy use in response to weather and price shocks. It develops a dual-margin framework that distinguishes between the extensive margin of energy portfolio adoption and the intensive margin of energy share allocation. The extensive margin is estimated using a multinomial probit model, while the intensive margin is estimated using a fractional multinomial logit model. Results show that mixed portfolios remain the dominant form of household energy use across income levels, locations, and electricity supply conditions. Weather shocks increase the need for energy services, but affordability and supply constraints determine whether households remain anchored in modern energy or shift towards greater reliance on traditional sources. Electricity serves as a modern energy anchor for high-income, urban, and supply-unconstrained households, while solid fuels serve as a fallback for low-income, rural, and supply-constrained households. The findings suggest that household energy transitions should not be understood as a simple movement up the energy ladder, but rather as adjustments to energy portfolios in response to weather shocks and affordability and supply reliability constraints. Thus, policies should focus on reliable, modern energy access, protection of affordability during weather- and price-related shocks, and differentiated support for vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了菲律宾家庭如何应对天气与价格冲击来组织其能源使用。研究构建了一个双边际分析框架，区分了能源组合采用的广延边际与能源份额分配的集约边际。广延边际采用多项概率模型进行估计，集约边际则采用分数多项逻辑模型进行估计。结果表明，混合能源组合仍是不同收入水平、地理位置和电力供应条件下家庭能源使用的主导形式。天气冲击增加了能源服务需求，但可负担性与供应约束决定了家庭是继续依赖现代能源，还是转向更多使用传统能源。电力作为高收入、城市及无供应约束家庭的现代能源锚点，而固体燃料则成为低收入、农村及供应受限家庭的备用选择。研究结论表明，家庭能源转型不应被简单理解为沿能源阶梯的线性攀升，而是家庭根据天气冲击、可负担性与供应可靠性约束对能源组合进行的动态调整。因此，政策应聚焦于可靠的现代能源接入、在天气与价格相关冲击期间保障可负担性，并对脆弱家庭提供差异化支持。
title: Beyond the energy ladder: household energy portfolios under weather and price shocks in the Philippines
title_zh: 超越能源阶梯：菲律宾天气与价格冲击下的家庭能源组合

abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on women’s entrepreneurship. Using data from the China Family Panel Studies over 2012–2020, we implement a staggered difference-in-differences design to estimate the causal effect of LTCI pilot implementation on women’s entrepreneurship. We find that LTCI significantly increases women’s likelihood of becoming entrepreneurs, with larger effects among households with lower wealth and those in which older family members are in poorer health. lowering young women’s perceived exposure to future risks and easing the caregiving demands they face within the family, thereby strengthening both their willingness and ability to engage in entrepreneurial activity. We further explore spillover effects on intrahousehold allocation and intergenerational outcomes. LTCI not only promotes women’s entrepreneurship but also narrows gender income disparities and improves children’s cognitive and non-cognitive development. Overall, our findings provide policy-relevant evidence for strengthening long-term care institutions and for designing complementary policies that advance women’s economic participation and gender equality.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国长期护理保险政策对女性创业的影响。基于2012-2020年中国家庭追踪调查数据，我们采用交错双重差分法估计长期护理保险试点实施对女性创业的因果效应。研究发现，长期护理保险显著提升了女性成为创业者的概率，这一效应在低财富家庭及家中老年成员健康状况较差的群体中更为显著。该政策通过降低年轻女性对未来风险的感知暴露度、缓解其家庭照护负担，从而增强了她们参与创业活动的意愿与能力。我们进一步探讨了该政策对家庭内部资源配置及代际结果的溢出效应：长期护理保险不仅促进了女性创业，还缩小了性别收入差距，并改善了子女的认知与非认知能力发展。总体而言，本研究为完善长期照护制度、设计促进女性经济参与及性别平等的配套政策提供了具有政策参考价值的实证依据。

title: Hidden support: long-term care insurance and women’s entrepreneurship
title_zh: 隐性支持：长期护理保险与女性创业

abstract: Using existing and new price data sets, we provide the first estimates of market integration across England over the entire 200 years of the industrial revolution. We document a significant, though not huge, integration improvement for markets furthest from London. Full integration was achieved by the 1830s. Our price data sets vary in quality (type of average, price rounding, frequency of stale prices). We show that this severely biases some standard statistical tests of market integration, and we develop and implement new techniques to ensure valid inference. We discuss the application of these techniques to other historical data sets.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用现有及新增的价格数据集，我们首次估算了工业革命整个200年间英格兰市场的整合程度。研究发现，距离伦敦最远的市场在整合方面取得了显著（尽管并非巨大）的改善。到19世纪30年代，市场已实现完全整合。我们的价格数据集在质量上存在差异（包括平均值类型、价格取整、陈旧价格频率）。我们证明，这些差异严重扭曲了某些市场整合的标准统计检验，并开发并实施了新技术以确保推断的有效性。我们还讨论了这些技术在其他历史数据集中的应用。
title: The big impact of small change: Fresh estimates of English wheat market integration, 1693–1893
title_zh: 小变化的巨大影响：英国小麦市场整合的新估计，1693–1893

abstract: Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.
abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所示那般具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的学术遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡建模、基于微观数据的方法的兴起，以及该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了其学术遗产。尽管数据与建模技术取得重大进展，我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——特别是收入基础的定义与企业所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对唯一最优方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心的经验与规范挑战，也解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续具有相关性的原因。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: On the 75th anniversary of Musgrave’s distribution of tax payments by income groups
title_zh: 穆斯卡夫按收入群体划分税收负担分配理论75周年纪念

abstract: Wealthier, risk-averse buyers pay more to speed up transactions in competitive search markets. This, coupled with forward-looking intermediaries who hold vacant homes overnight, implies that a credit expansion produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes over time. This boom is due to a combination of two effects. First, search and matching frictions imply that buyers are willing to pay a higher price to trade faster, not only to consume housing services. Second, the fact that intermediaries are forward-looking implies that trading probabilities today depend on the future evolution of prices. Since agents forecast that prices are higher than in the initial steady state, they turn to trading today. Our theory produces a boom in prices that slowly recedes and a gradual rise of homeownership rate.
abstract_zh: 更富裕且风险规避的买家在竞争性搜索市场中愿意支付更高价格以加速交易。这一现象，加之持有空置房屋过夜的具有前瞻性的中介机构，意味着信贷扩张会引发价格繁荣，随后随时间缓慢回落。这种繁荣源于两种效应的结合。首先，搜索与匹配摩擦意味着买家不仅为了消费住房服务，还为了更快达成交易而愿意支付更高价格。其次，中介机构的前瞻性意味着今日的交易概率取决于价格的未来走势。由于主体预测价格高于初始稳态水平，他们转向今日交易。我们的理论产生了价格缓慢回落及住房拥有率逐步上升的繁荣景象。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Credit and inventories in illiquid housing markets
title_zh: 流动性不足的住房市场中的信贷与库存

abstract: This paper examines the within-conference relationship between nonverbal features of the Bank of Japan governor and post-answer realized volatility of Japanese Government Bond futures. Using 1,557 question-and-answer segments from 79 post-meeting press conferences during 2016-2026, I regress realized volatility of Japanese Government Bond futures on principal component indices of facial and audio features extracted from conference videos. Facial indicators exhibit a significant positive association with volatility, even after controlling for verbal policy stance, policy surprises, and governor fixed effects. The short-horizon correlation is preserved under a censored-RV robustness check that addresses overlap with subsequent answers, while longer windows attenuate.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了日本央行行长在会议中的非语言特征与答问环节后日本政府债券期货已实现波动率之间的会议内关系。利用2016-2026年间79次会后新闻发布会的1，557个问答片段，我将日本政府债券期货的已实现波动率对从会议视频中提取的面部和音频特征主成分指数进行回归。面部指标与波动率呈现显著正相关，即使在控制言语政策立场、政策意外及行长固定效应后依然如此。在应对后续回答重叠问题的截尾已实现波动率稳健性检验下，短期限相关性得以保持，而较长时间窗口则趋于减弱。
title: Nonverbal Signals and Market Uncertainty: Evidence from Bank of Japan Press Conferences
title_zh: 非语言信号与市场不确定性：来自日本央行新闻发布会的证据

abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。
title: Short-Term Reversal Persists Globally—If Properly Measured
title_zh: 短期反转在全球范围内持续存在——若测量得当

abstract: We show that positive flows to active mutual funds with high recent returns partially reverse at longer horizons. This outcome is robust across a broad range of alternative specifications. Reversal occurs from greater outflows associated with high prior returns, not reduced inflows. We test theories to explain the reversal: investment life cycles, tax loss selling, and a behavioral “disappointment” hypothesis based on investors’ overreaction to positive returns. While both tax loss selling and short investor life cycles can contribute, the evidence supports a role for investor disappointment, whereby investors redeem their capital when return performance fails to meet expectations. (JEL G10, G23)
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们证明，近期回报率较高的主动型共同基金的正向资金流入在较长时期内会出现部分逆转。这一结果在多种替代性设定下均保持稳健。逆转源于高前期回报带来的更大规模资金流出，而非流入减少。我们检验了三种解释逆转的理论：投资生命周期、税收损失出售以及基于投资者对正回报过度反应的行为"失望"假说。尽管税收损失出售和较短的投资生命周期均可能发挥作用，但证据支持投资者失望假说的作用，即当回报表现未达预期时，投资者会赎回其资本。（JEL G10, G23）
title: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
title_zh: 长期视角下的共同基金资金流动

abstract: The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.
abstract_zh: 摘要 伍德福德（1998）中著名的无现金限制性结论已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结论，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结论不再成立。这一具有影响力的结论的脆弱性，应当让广泛基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的做法有所反思。
title:
onetary Economics
                    at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies
title_zh: 货币经济学30年：无现金极限货币经济中货币相关性的再审视

abstract: I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业中的工人分散于整个工资分布下半部分，但为何中位数工资却出现下降；2）为何在技术变革持续进行的情况下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业中技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，我验证了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违反了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入了一种“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等

abstract: The Integrated Phase Classification (IPC) is the global standard for analyzing and classifying food insecurity, including famine. While media attention tends to focus on IPC famine analyses, the IPC conducts most of its analyses in non-famine contexts, providing critical assessments of sub-national food insecurity. These analyses guide considerable humanitarian intervention and investment. We argue that IPC analyses are most valuable and effective when users understand the processes, data, and methodological safeguards that underlie and inform IPC findings. We present and discuss seven essential characteristics to clarify IPC operations and interpretation including its analysis framework, consensus-based processes, reporting output interpretation, and famine classification protocols. These seven characteristics are key to the IPC’s capacity to monitor dynamic, overlapping and chronic circumstances of food insecurity. We discuss the strengths and limitations of these characteristics, and we work through implications for interpreting and applying IPC outputs. While our primary objective is to clarify IPC processes, we conclude with a section that is more normative, discussing the IPC’s role and significance in the current global humanitarian system. At a time of significant strain on the humanitarian system and in the face of a loss of practitioner expertise at all levels, a more complete understanding of the IPC’s processes will enhance its utility in an increasingly constrained humanitarian landscape.
abstract_zh: 综合阶段分类（IPC）是全球分析粮食不安全（包括饥荒）的标准。尽管媒体关注往往聚焦于IPC饥荒分析，但IPC在非饥荒情境下进行了大部分分析，提供了对次国家级粮食不安全状况的关键评估。这些分析指导了大量人道主义干预和投资。我们认为，当用户理解支撑并告知IPC发现的过程、数据和方法论保障时，IPC分析最具价值和有效性。我们提出并讨论了七个关键特征，以阐明IPC的操作和解读，包括其分析框架、基于共识的过程、报告输出的解读以及饥荒分类协议。这七个特征对于IPC监测动态、重叠及慢性粮食不安全状况的能力至关重要。我们讨论了这些特征的优势与局限，并探讨了其对解读和应用IPC输出的启示。虽然我们的主要目标是澄清IPC过程，但我们在结尾部分转向更具规范性的讨论，探讨IPC在当前全球人道主义体系中的角色和意义。在人道主义体系面临重大压力、各级从业者专业知识流失之际，更全面地理解IPC过程将增强其在日益受限的人道主义环境中的实用性。
title: The integrated food security phase classification system: seven defining characteristics
title_zh: 综合粮食安全阶段分类系统：七个定义性特征

abstract: Equitable access to healthcare requires efficient allocation of health infrastructure, yet politics may distort these decisions. This paper studies how politicians distort public hospital allocations in postcolonial Malaysia from 1959 to 2013. Malaysia first allocates hospital funding to districts, then selects specific locations within funded districts for construction. Using six decades of data on hospital construction and elections, I find that constituencies represented by deputy ministers are significantly more likely to receive new hospitals, but only at the location selection stage within districts. District-level funding decisions effectively direct resources to districts far from existing hospitals. I provide suggestive evidence that measurable guidelines for funding decisions exist but not for construction site selection. These results suggest that defining clear guidelines in hospital allocation can limit political distortions.
abstract_zh: 公平获得医疗服务要求卫生基础设施的高效配置，然而政治因素可能扭曲这些决策。本文研究了1959年至2013年间马来西亚后殖民时期政治家如何扭曲公立医院的分配。马来西亚首先将医院资金分配给各地区，然后在获得资金的地区内选择具体建设地点。利用六十年间医院建设和选举的数据，我发现由副部长代表的选区显著更有可能获得新医院，但这仅发生在地区内的选址阶段。地区层面的资金分配决策有效地将资源导向远离现有医院的地区。我提供了暗示性证据表明，资金分配决策存在可衡量的指导方针，但建设选址则不然。这些结果表明，在医院分配中明确清晰的指导方针可以限制政治扭曲。
title: Hospital allocation and politicians: Evidence from Malaysia
title_zh: 医院分配与政治家：来自马来西亚的证据

abstract: Land consolidation is increasingly recognized as a key instrument for promoting low-carbon land-use transitions. However, its effectiveness varies under different policy orientations, and how to design strategies for whole-region integrated land consolidation remains insufficiently understood. We develop a systematic approach to identify and prioritize land consolidation potential under alternative land-use optimization pathways. Four low-carbon land-use scenarios are constructed for Shenzhen, China, and future land-use configurations are simulated using a multi-objective optimization approach coupled with the Patch-generating Land Use Simulation model. Land consolidation potential into six types, which enables spatial prioritization of consolidation interventions across the whole region. Results reveal strong scenario dependence in land consolidation patterns. High-priority areas are dominated by ecological restoration for carbon sequestration (37.16%) under the carbon emission reduction preference scenario, construction intensive consolidation area (99.54%) under the economic development preference scenario, and ecological protection for carbon sequestration (98.00%) under the ecological protection preference scenario. Under the balanced multi-objective scenario, no high-potential areas are identified; instead, medium-potential zones dominated by ecological protection for carbon sequestration (97.22%) prevail, indicating that ecological land remains critical to overall land-use benefits. The study advances a multifunctional land consolidation framework that links land-use zoning with policy objectives and provides theoretical insights into coordinated land-use optimization and practical implications for differentiated land consolidation strategies in rapidly urbanizing regions.
abstract_zh: 土地整治日益被认为是促进低碳土地利用转型的关键工具。然而，其效果在不同政策导向下存在差异，且如何设计全域土地综合整治策略仍缺乏充分理解。我们开发了一种系统方法，用于在替代性土地利用优化路径下识别和优先排序土地整治潜力。针对中国深圳构建了四种低碳土地利用情景，并采用多目标优化方法结合斑块生成土地利用模拟模型，对未来土地利用配置进行模拟。将土地整治潜力划分为六种类型，从而实现了全域整治干预的空间优先排序。结果表明，土地整治模式具有显著的情景依赖性。在碳减排偏好情景下，高优先级区域以生态修复固碳为主（37.16%）；在经济发展偏好情景下，以建设集约整治区为主（99.54%）；在生态保护偏好情景下，以生态保护固碳为主（98.00%）。在均衡多目标情景下，未识别出高潜力区域；相反，以生态保护固碳为主的中等潜力区域（97.22%）占主导，表明生态用地对整体土地利用效益仍至关重要。本研究推进了将土地利用分区与政策目标相衔接的多功能土地整治框架，为协调土地利用优化提供了理论洞见，并为快速城市化地区差异化土地整治策略提供了实践启示。

title: Exploring land consolidation solutions towards land use low-carbon transition: Evidence from Shenzhen, China
title_zh: 面向土地利用低碳转型的土地整治方案探索：来自中国深圳的证据

abstract: Using data on millions of individual for-sale home listings, we estimate that new seller entrants cause an immediate reduction in their competitors’ probability of selling, suggesting significant search congestion externalities. Competitor prices, however, are much less responsive. Our estimates imply that shocks to the for-sale supply — such as the recent sharp decline in new listings due to mortgage lock-in — play a limited role in explaining short-run house price fluctuations. We also show evidence of buyers directing their search by time on market, as new listings compete for buyers more intensively with each other than with older listings.
abstract_zh: 利用数百万条个人待售房源挂牌数据，我们估计新卖家进入市场会立即降低其竞争对手的售出概率，这表明存在显著的搜索拥挤外部性。然而，竞争对手的价格反应则相对较弱。我们的估计表明，待售供给冲击——例如近期因抵押贷款锁定效应导致的新挂牌房源急剧减少——在解释短期房价波动方面作用有限。我们还提供了证据，显示买家会根据房源在市场上的时间长短来引导其搜索，新挂牌房源彼此之间的竞争比与较旧房源的竞争更为激烈。
title: Housing market congestion: The effects of new for-sale supply on home prices and sale hazards
title_zh: 住房市场拥堵：新增待售房源对房价与销售风险的影响

abstract: There is no consensus on how to measure social welfare and inequality when households have different needs. As we show, a dilemma emerges between holding households responsible for their needs or compensating them. This dilemma is of first-order importance for social welfare, but generally plays a minor role in the measurement of inequality. To address this impasse, we introduce partial compensation. Our axiomatic characterizations reveal novel families of welfare criteria and, with the extension to multidimensional commodity spaces, provide ready-to-use criteria for the analysis of redistributive policies.
abstract_zh: 在家庭需求各异的情况下，如何衡量社会福利与不平等尚无共识。正如我们所展示的，在让家庭对其需求负责与对其进行补偿之间，出现了一种两难困境。这一困境对社会福利具有首要重要性，但在不平等衡量中通常作用甚微。为化解此僵局，我们引入了部分补偿机制。我们的公理化特征刻画揭示了新颖的福利准则家族，并通过对多维商品空间的扩展，为再分配政策分析提供了即用型准则。
title: Equity and efficiency when needs differ
title_zh: 需求差异下的公平与效率

abstract: The paper develops a new monetarist DSGE model to examine the macroeconomic implications of fiat-money-backed stablecoins and the effectiveness of prudential policies in mitigating associated risks. The model features two segmented sectors: a centralized real economy where fiat money facilitates consumption and investment, and a decentralized virtual economy characterized by anonymous bilateral search and matching, in which transactions are exclusively conducted using stablecoins. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the simulation results reveal that stablecoins amplify the propagation of exogenous shocks to key macroeconomic variables by weakening the effectiveness of monetary policy. However, prudential regulations—specifically those governing the backing ratio of stablecoins to fiat-denominated reserve assets, analogous to banking liquidity requirements—can serve as stabilizing instruments, dampening volatility and enhancing macroeconomic resilience in the presence of stablecoins.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新型货币主义DSGE模型，以研究由法定货币支持的稳定币的宏观经济影响，以及审慎政策在缓解相关风险方面的有效性。该模型包含两个分割的部门：一个集中的实体经济部门，其中法定货币促进消费和投资；一个去中心化的虚拟经济部门，其特征是匿名双边搜索与匹配，交易仅使用稳定币进行。基于美国经济数据的校准模拟结果显示，稳定币通过削弱货币政策的有效性，放大了外生冲击对关键宏观经济变量的传导效应。然而，审慎监管——特别是针对稳定币与法定计价储备资产支持比率的监管（类似于银行流动性要求）——可作为稳定工具，在存在稳定币的情况下抑制波动性并增强宏观经济韧性。
authors: Hui He & Yao Zhao & Dayong Zhou
title: Stablecoins and Macroeconomic Stability: A DSGE Investigation
title_zh: 稳定币与宏观经济稳定性：一项DSGE研究

abstract: Climate disasters tend to be associated with increased sovereign default risk. Countries face an “impossible trilemma”: scale up adaptation investment, keep debt sustainable amidst high borrowing costs and avoid the higher risk of default from delayed adaptation. Using a global panel of disaster event-level shocks, we find that a 1pp increase in disaster related losses as a share of GDP raises the odds of sovereign default by approximately 2-3 percent. An additional US$1 billion in cumulative Official Development Assistance (ODA) is associated with a 0.13 point gain in a country’s adaptive capacity. Using average marginal effects and our predicted margins we then map concessional ODA finance to default probability and translate these relationships into a practical budgeting yardstick for calibrating needed ODA to sovereign default risk reduction targets. In a context of declining ODA, our findings highlight the crucial role of well-designed support in climate adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 气候灾害往往与主权违约风险上升相关。各国面临一个"不可能三角"：扩大适应投资规模、在高借贷成本下维持债务可持续性、以及避免因延迟适应而导致的更高违约风险。基于全球灾害事件冲击层面的面板数据，我们发现灾害相关损失占GDP比重每增加1个百分点，主权违约概率将上升约2-3%。累计官方发展援助每增加10亿美元，与一国适应能力提升0.13个点相关。通过运用平均边际效应与预测边际值，我们将优惠性官方发展援助资金映射至违约概率，并将这些关系转化为实用的预算标尺，用于校准实现主权违约风险降低目标所需的官方发展援助。在官方发展援助持续缩减的背景下，我们的研究凸显了精心设计的支持在气候适应政策中的关键作用。
authors: Constance de Soyres & Emmanuella Obeng & Joanne Tan
title: Climate Shocks, Debt Defaults and Investment in Climate Adaptation – Squaring an Impossible Trilemma
title_zh: 气候冲击、债务违约与气候适应投资——破解不可能三角

abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.
abstract_zh: 企业层面的地缘经济风险甚至可能影响广泛分散化的共同基金投资组合。本文研究美国出于国家安全原因限制向特定中国企业销售尖端技术的出口管制政策。受政策影响的国内供应商股价在政策出台后立即下跌。持有这些股票的共同基金面临波动性上升和回报率下降。基金经理通过抛售对华出口企业股票、购买彩票型股票以及提高投资组合集中度来应对。虽然选股能力和择时能力无助于应对风险，但专业型基金和高费率基金在规避地缘经济风险方面表现更优。

title: Navigating Geopolitical Risk: Evidence from U.S. Mutual Funds
title_zh: 驾驭地缘政治风险：来自美国共同基金的证据

abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。
title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角

abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。
title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据

abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。
authors: Nils H. Lehr & Johanna Schauer & Hugo Tuesta
title: Minimum Wages and the Informality Constraint
title_zh: 最低工资与非正规约束

abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。

title: Long-term Effects of US Tariff Increases on CAPDR
title_zh: 美国关税上调对中美洲、巴拿马和多米尼加共和国（CAPDR）的长期影响

abstract: Housing affordability is high on the economic, social, and political agenda in Europe. While the economic literature has mostly analyzed the drivers of housing unaffordability, this paper focuses on its consequences, quantifying, at the EU level, its impact on individuals’ well-being as well as its economic and demographic impact. We find that the impact of an increase in housing cost burden is large on housing adequacy as well as on poverty and health. It is somewhat smaller on fertility and labor force participation.
abstract_zh: 住房可负担性在欧洲的经济、社会和政治议程中占据重要地位。尽管经济学文献主要分析了住房不可负担性的驱动因素，本文则聚焦于其后果，在欧盟层面量化其对个人福祉的影响，以及其经济和人口层面的影响。研究发现，住房成本负担增加对住房适足性、贫困和健康的影响较大，而对生育率和劳动力参与率的影响相对较小。
title: The (Many) Consequences of the Housing Affordability Problem in the EU: A Machine-Learning Empirical Analysis
title_zh: 欧盟住房可负担性问题的（多重）后果：一项基于机器学习的实证分析
